verdict.rationale: Authy's only programmatic surface is the Authy API and SDKs for server-side 2FA integration (authy-docs-1, authy-docs-13), which could in principle be driven headlessly. However, Twilio's docs state the Authy API is closed to new customers and slated for full deprecation, with Verify v2 as the successor (authy-probe-rt-1). Nothing shows the authenticator app itself running headlessly or in CI. Missing for 10: an open programmatic surface for new users, a CLI or headless mode for the authenticator, CI/automation documentation, and hands-on corroboration.
